passes.purpose: Combine selected structures and unify material art direction
passes.prompt:
Use case: compositing with a unified art-direction paintover.
Asset type: a single 16:9 full-screen fantasy personal portfolio world-map concept preview. Not a production webpage.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and overall composition: preserve its lower-left SKILLS wind-powered workshop, upper-right PROJECTS open exhibition pavilion, and lower-right CONTACT lighthouse harbor. Input image 2 is a SUPPORTING INSERT: transfer ONLY its upper-left ABOUT ancient tree-root archive, replacing the cliff library in image 1. Do not transfer the waterwheel workshop from image 2.
Keep the four selected architectural silhouettes, positions, relative sizes and functions: ABOUT sprawling old tree embracing a low circular stone archive with round doorway, readable bookshelves, desk and roof oculus; SKILLS tall helical off-white canvas wind rotor on a bronze mast driving a physically connected gear shaft beside a circular making table on stepped stone ruins; PROJECTS largest island with grand folded butterfly roof, broad steps and FOUR blank exhibition surfaces (outer horizontal, inner portrait); CONTACT slender lighthouse with external spiral stair beside crescent water basin and dock. Roof tips, tree canopy, rotor and lighthouse fully inside the frame. Clear sky gaps separate all four islands. Maintain the monumental scale.
Primary requested change beyond compositing: decisively replace the glossy, over-detailed AI miniature finish with a coherent hand-painted game environment look. Use the broad painted shapes, matte material response and deliberate simplified light/shadow organization associated with Zelda Breath of the Wild / Tears of the Kingdom environment art, while preserving these original portfolio-specific designs. This is an intentional environment artist paintover, not a blanket blur, faded filter or watercolor paper texture.
Color and material direction: natural cerulean sky with restrained saturation, large soft ivory clouds, warm chalk limestone, cool blue-grey rock shadow, muted sage and moss greens. Spring ABOUT has sparse dusty pink blossom masses mixed with green rather than candy-colored individual flowers. Summer SKILLS has cooler green foliage. Autumn PROJECTS has a few subdued ochre/olive trees, no bright yellow-gold foliage. CONTACT has sparse evergreen and bare winter branches, subtle frost. Seasonal accent colors occupy small areas; all islands share the same palette foundation and light source.
Material discipline: paint stone with large angular planes, a few purposeful seams and weather marks, NOT hundreds of identical rounded chips. Canopies read as asymmetrical grouped leaf masses, not individually outlined leaves or cauliflower beads. Paint matte off-white canvas with simple folds; bronze is aged and non-shiny. Project roof is matte grey-green stone and restrained timber, not glowing gold. Water uses clear muted turquoise body shapes, selective pale foam, and vertical stroke grouping, not luminous white-blue neon ribbons. About has short stepped cascades, Skills has a winding shallow channel and split narrow falls, Projects has a strong single waterfall through its central chasm, Contact a single edge spill from its harbor. Physically readable water origins.
One common daylight source from upper left. Establish only 2-3 principal value groups per material. Broad calm midtones, cool soft cast shadows, brightest highlights reserved for a few water edges. Remove rim lighting, bloom, plastic gloss, HDR, procedural microtexture, excessive sparkling details and golden lamps. Sharpness and detail belong selectively at doorways, rotor mechanism and gallery displays; secondary rocks and distant mountains remain simply painted but legible. No grey wash and no muddy desaturation.
Keep only the existing small clean unboxed dark captions verbatim: ABOUT, SKILLS, PROJECTS, CONTACT, in clear sky below the corresponding islands. No additional header, UI, badges, new islands, people, invented project screenshots, glowing magic crystals or decorative particles. Deliver one cohesive wide image showing the selected four-island combination.

passes.purpose: Further simplify stone and vegetation detail while preserving selected structures
passes.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer, targeted material paintover of this exact approved composition.
Preserve ALL four islands' architecture, silhouettes, relative scale, positions and labels in the attached image. ABOUT tree-root circular archive at upper left; SKILLS helical canvas wind rotor and circular maker table at lower left; PROJECTS monumental folded-roof open gallery with four blank panels at upper right; CONTACT spiral-stair lighthouse and small harbor at lower right. Keep all these unchanged structurally. Do not redesign objects.
The single requested edit is a visibly stronger hand-painted 2.5D game-background surface treatment across the entire image. Current surfaces look too much like a uniformly over-detailed miniature 3D render. Repaint rather than apply a photo filter. Aim for the art direction of an actual hand-authored Zelda-style environment production painting with intentional broad flat paint shapes, subtly textured color planes and simple soft cel-like light separation. Preserve convincing depth and gentle daylight.
Critical material correction: replace the many small rounded faceted stones on the cliffs with LARGE continuous irregular rock masses and only a few major cracks. Remove at least two thirds of tiny stone chips, pale leaf rims, dotted ground flowers, small masonry texture, and individual leaf details. Trees must have generous flat silhouette leaf clusters painted in three restrained sage/olive value masses with a few clear branches. Do not outline every leaf. Pink flowers on ABOUT should be muted dusty rose patches, not individually modeled petals. Roof and stairs remain carefully drawn but much less granular.
Reduce yellow highlights and orange-brown coloration; use warm off-white stone, neutral brown timber, cool slate blue-green shadows, natural subdued green foliage, sparse muted ochre autumn patches, quieter dusty pink spring accents. Soft blue sky and grouped broad cloud masses. Do not desaturate to grey, keep fresh atmospheric daylight. Metal and canvas remain matte, no shine. Paint flowing water with a quiet translucent blue-green body and only a few broad white foam strokes. No sparkling white zigzags covering the whole waterfall. Keep physical water routes and each waterfall layout.
Focal sharpness at archive doorway, wind mechanism, four gallery panels, lighthouse lantern; surrounding vegetation and background painted with simpler edges. Clearly distinguish focal edges from secondary edges. NOT photorealism, NOT Pixar miniature, NOT clay diorama, NOT glossy high-poly render, NOT maximal microdetail, NOT bloom, no noisy paper grain, no outlines added around objects. Keep only the four existing captions ABOUT / SKILLS / PROJECTS / CONTACT. Maintain 16:9 full-image framing. This is a single cohesive landscape preview, not split panels.
